name: Nex

mechanics.name: Attuned Followers
mechanics.description: Four mages stand in the corners of the room, one for each element. Each becomes attackable at a fixed point in the fight and has to die before Nex will move on.
mechanics.counterplay: Kill each one the moment it turns attackable. Nex cannot be pushed into her next phase while hers is still standing.

mechanics.name: Smoke Phase
mechanics.description: She rushes with smoke that can poison, drags players in close and stuns them, and darts down an aisle hitting everyone standing in the line.
mechanics.counterplay: Stay in melee range so she picks her single-target attack instead of magic, and bring an antipoison.

mechanics.name: Shadow Phase
mechanics.description: She switches to shadow shots at range, drops a deadly shadow under every player at once, and can darken the room so that standing anywhere near her burns you down.
mechanics.counterplay: Pray Protect from Missiles and fight from maximum distance. Step off your tile the moment a shadow appears under it.

mechanics.name: Blood Phase
mechanics.description: She barrages to heal herself off you, kneels and summons blood reavers while every hit she takes heals her, and marks one player who has to get clear before it lands.
mechanics.counterplay: Kill the reavers, stop attacking while she kneels, and run seven tiles the instant you are marked.

mechanics.name: Ice Phase
mechanics.description: She barrages to freeze you in place, smashes the floor to raise icicles across a wide square, and seals one player inside a ring of stalagmites.
mechanics.counterplay: Keep Protect from Magic up so the freeze does not stick, and break a prison open with stab or crush before it closes on you.

mechanics.name: Zaros Phase
mechanics.description: She heals, drops the elements entirely, and turns on Zarosian prayers: Turmoil to sap your stats, Soul Split to heal off every hit, and Deflect Melee to send your own damage back. Her death sets off a blast around her body.
mechanics.counterplay: Camp Protect from Melee, and stop attacking before she dies so the blast does not catch you.

_note: SKELETON, NOT LIVE-VERIFIED. Ids come from Jagex's own gameval names rather than guesses, but nothing here has been confirmed in a live fight. Provenance: gamevals from runelite-api 1.12.35 (net.runelite.api.gameval.*), because this cache download ships an empty GAMEVALS index (idx24) and ScanGameVal cannot read it; npc names, models, sequences and extents from the live cache (revision of 2026-08-06). Npc ids: NEX 11278, NEX_SPAWNING 11279, NEX_SOULSPLIT 11280, NEX_DEFLECT 11281 and NEX_DYING 11282 are all in npcIds, because Nex swaps npc id as her Zarosian prayers change rather than spawning a new npc, and an npc transform has to be tracked as the boss for her animations to keep matching (docs/DECISIONS.md D17). The four attuned followers (Fumus 11283, Umbra 11284, Cruor 11285, Glacies 11286) and the blood reavers (11293, 11294) are deliberately NOT in npcIds: they are adds, so they detect on npc-spawn, the same call already shipped for Zulrah's snakelings. Animations, all unambiguous gameval names: NEX_ATTACK 9180, NEX_CAST_ATTACK 9189, NEX_DASH_ATTACK 9178, NEX_BLOOD_SIPHON 9183, NEX_SMASH_ATTACK 9186 and NEX_TURMOIL 9179. NEX_SMASH_ATTACK 9186 IS CURATED AS CONTAINMENT ON AN INFERENCE: the wiki describes containment as smashing the floor to raise icicles around her, which is the only floor smash in her move list, but the gameval name says only 'smash' and the shadow phase also has a floor-targeted mechanic, so the live pass should confirm 9186 is not in fact the shadow smash. NEX_BLAST_AWAY 9182, NEX_SPIN_OUT 9187, NEX_ALTERNATE_CAST_ATTACK 9188 and NEX_SUMMON 9202 are named but unassigned; they are the candidates for the mechanics missing below. DETECTION IS ANIMATION AND NPC-SPAWN ONLY, BY DELIBERATE CHOICE FOR EVERY SKELETON IN THIS WAVE. Projectile triggers fall back to a boss-presence gate when the game reports no source actor, and graphic triggers have no source actor at all (docs/DECISIONS.md D17), so an unverified id of either kind can false-positive, and discovery never revokes (D18). NEX_BLOOD_SIPHON_SPOTANIM 9190, NEX_TURMOIL_SPOTANIM 9191, NEX_SPOT_SOULSPLIT_PROJ 9197, NEX_SPOT_LEECH_PROJ 9198, _IMPACT 9199 and NEX_MUSHROOM_CLOUD_PROJANIM 9200 / _SPOTANIM 9201 are the ids to add during the live pass. Several signature mechanics are consequently absent: choke, drag, shadow smash, embrace darkness, blood sacrifice, ice prison and the death wrath all key off spotanims or player-side effects rather than a distinct body animation, and none of them is curated rather than being hung on a wrong trigger. THE FOLLOWERS PREVIEW USES UMBRA 11284 SPECIFICALLY. Fumus, Cruor and Glacies each carry a six-pair recolour table over the same shared base models, and under SCHEMA.md's recolor-table rule a widget cannot apply an npc's recolour table, so all three would render in the wrong colour. Umbra alone has no recolour table, so it is the one follower that previews colour-true. It plays the generic HUMAN_READY 808 standing animation, per docs/DECISIONS.md D26's prefer-the-idle guidance. Its zoom is raised above FitZoom's own fit for the same reason four models in this wave are: its vertical envelope sits entirely above the ground line the engine anchors to, so the shiftY that centres it projects past the 70px half-box ceiling BundledBossDataTest enforces, and raising zoom shrinks the model and its offset by the same factor. Nex's own five previews all fit inside the ceiling and ship at FitZoom's values. staticFallback is false on all six; whether each body animation reads has not been eyeballed in game. The collection log page is titled 'Nex', matching 'name'. REDO 2026-08-07 (Andrew asked for a full list rewrite): The list is now the six rows Andrew specified, in his order, researched against the wiki fight overview. CONFIDENT IDS: the four followers are NEX_SMOKEMAGE 11283, NEX_SHADOWMAGE 11284, NEX_BLOODMAGE 11285 and NEX_ICEMAGE 11286; smoke is NEX_DASH_ATTACK 9178, the smoke dash; blood is NEX_BLOOD_SIPHON 9183 plus the two blood reaver ids; ice is NEX_SMASH_ATTACK 9186, the floor smash that raises the icicles; and zaros is NEX_TURMOIL 9179 plus npc-spawns NEX_SOULSPLIT 11280 and NEX_DEFLECT 11281, which are transforms that only ever happen in that phase and are therefore the strongest triggers in the file (docs/DECISIONS.md D17). NEX DOES NOT TRANSFORM PER ELEMENTAL PHASE, which was the first thing checked: 11279 through 11282 are NEX_SPAWNING, NEX_SOULSPLIT, NEX_DEFLECT and NEX_DYING, all Zaros-phase prayer states, so phase detection has to come from the animations. THE SHADOW ROW IS THE WEAK ONE: 9187 NEX_SPIN_OUT and 9182 NEX_BLAST_AWAY are the only unclaimed animations left in her set and are curated as Shadow Smash and Embrace Darkness on that basis alone, not on a name that says so. Verify that row before any of the others.
